---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Ashlan Guengerich"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb")
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, year, rla_score) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score, names_prefix = "rla_") |>
  filter(!is.na(rla_2015), !is.na(rla_2023)) |>
  mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  collect()

state_change <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, year, rla_score) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score, names_prefix = "rla_") |>
  filter(!is.na(rla_2015), !is.na(rla_2023)) |>
  mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, boundary = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in School District Reading Scores (2015 to 2023)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Most of the ",
      scales::comma(nrow(score_change)),
      " U.S. school districts saw reading scores decline"
    ),
    x = "Change in Reading Score (2023 - 2015)",
    y = "Number of Districts",
    caption = "Source: Stanford Education Data Archive (SEDA 2025)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
state_change |>
  mutate(state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, rla_2023)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = rla_2015), color = "gray60", size = 1.5) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = rla_2015,
      xend = rla_2023,
      yend = state_name,
      color = rla_change > 0
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Score Changes from 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "Arrows point from 2015 score (gray dot) to 2023 score, sorted by 2023 performance",
    x = "Reading Score (Grade-Level Equivalents from National Average)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Stanford Education Data Archive (SEDA 2025)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
